description: This file is a PHP source script for rendering the Calendar ListView in a CRM system, specifically VtigerCRM. It manages list view configurations, custom views, sorting, querying, and rendering of calendar activities and tasks.

classes.name: ListViewSession
classes.description: Class managing sessions for list views, including view change detection.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class for rendering CRM views.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Model representing a calendar activity, with initialization and sorting functionalities.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Class for managing custom views within modules, including view retrieval and permission checks.

methods.name: getWhereCondition
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL WHERE condition for filtering the list view.

methods.name: getAssignedTo
methods.description: Retrieves list of users and groups for assignment options.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query to retrieve list view data.
